# Metodologia

## Metodologia

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="49%"}
<div style="background:#e3efe6; border:1.5px solid #3f6b52; border-radius:14px; padding:1.4rem 1.5rem; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; height:100%; text-align:left;">
<h3 style="font-size:1.05em; font-weight:700; color:#10241d; margin:0;">🏷️ Covariáveis Qualitativas</h3>
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3); border-radius:10px; padding:11px 16px;">
<div style="flex:0 0 1.8em; width:1.8em; height:1.8em; border-radius:50%; background:#3f6b52; color:#ffffff; font-size:0.78em; font-weight:800; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">1</div>
<div style="flex:1;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;"><div style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.64em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52;">survfit()</div><div style="font-size:0.7em; font-weight:700; color:#10241d;">Kaplan-Meier</div></div>
<div style="font-size:0.54em; color:#6b7d73;">Estimação das curvas de sobrevida</div>
</div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3); border-radius:10px; padding:11px 16px;">
<div style="flex:0 0 1.8em; width:1.8em; height:1.8em; border-radius:50%; background:#3f6b52; color:#ffffff; font-size:0.78em; font-weight:800; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">2</div>
<div style="flex:1;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;"><div style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.64em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52;">survdiff()</div><div style="font-size:0.7em; font-weight:700; color:#10241d;">Log-Rank</div></div>
<div style="font-size:0.54em; color:#6b7d73;">Teste de igualdade das curvas de sobrevida</div>
</div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3); border-radius:10px; padding:11px 16px;">
<div style="flex:0 0 1.8em; width:1.8em; height:1.8em; border-radius:50%; background:#3f6b52; color:#ffffff; font-size:0.78em; font-weight:800; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">3</div>
<div style="flex:1;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;"><div style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.64em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52;">survdiff(rho=1)</div><div style="font-size:0.7em; font-weight:700; color:#10241d;">Peto-Peto</div></div>
<div style="font-size:0.54em; color:#6b7d73;">Teste com maior peso às diferenças no início do seguimento</div>
</div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3); border-radius:10px; padding:11px 16px;">
<div style="flex:0 0 1.8em; width:1.8em; height:1.8em; border-radius:50%; background:#3f6b52; color:#ffffff; font-size:0.78em; font-weight:800; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">4</div>
<div style="flex:1;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;"><div style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.64em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52;">pairwise_survdiff()</div><div style="font-size:0.7em; font-weight:700; color:#10241d;">Holm-Bonferroni</div></div>
<div style="font-size:0.54em; color:#6b7d73;">Comparações par a par com correção para múltiplos testes</div>
</div>
</div>
<div style="font-size:0.55em; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; color:#6b7d73; margin-top:6px;">Aplicada a</div>
<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:9px;">
<div style="font-size:0.57em; padding:3px 13px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:600; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.35);">SEXO</div>
<div style="font-size:0.57em; padding:3px 13px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:600; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.35);">ESCOLARI</div>
<div style="font-size:0.57em; padding:3px 13px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:600; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.35);">ECGRUP</div>
<div style="font-size:0.57em; padding:3px 13px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:600; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.35);">CATEATEND</div>
<div style="font-size:0.57em; padding:3px 13px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:600; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.35);">CIRURGIA</div>
